in_sanskrit.name: मालकित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who chants or describes the syllables of the Omkara (ॐ) mantra.

in_hindi.name: मालकित
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who wears a garland or one who is adorned with a rosary.

in_tamil.name: மாலகித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is decorated or bedecked with flowers or jewels.

in_telugu.name: మాలకిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who possesses a beautiful, adorned, or decorated body.

in_marathi.name: Malkit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the fort
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malkit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Malkit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'mala' (garland) and 'kita' (fort). It is believed to be the name of the lord of the fort or the one who wears the garland of victory.
